calendar_inputs.age_end_definition: age_end(y_inv, y) = sum_{k = y_inv..y} num_years_k (k over the case-file Years map in order); 0 for y < y_inv (empty sum: the pair is outside the cohort, rated is fixed 0)

static_code_sites.bound: lb 0; ub = 0 if inactive else e_capacity * ESS_DAY_BALANCE_SLACK_FRACTION (0.05) + EQUALITY_TOLERANCE
[0, 0] if inactive else the capacity-INDEPENDENT (0, None) / (None, None)
FIXED at 0 if inactive, unfixed otherwise (a fixing, not a bound); shared_es_soc VALUE reset to e_capacity * ENERGY_STORAGE_RELATIVE_INIT_SOC (an initial value, not a bound)
constant (0, 1); every other shared-ESS Var is declared with a domain only
ESSO: es_soh_per_unit_cumul bounds constant (0, 1); every other Var domain-only; fixings depend on the calendar-life window and on cohort capacity == 0 only (zero-gated), never on its value
ADN interface / DSO reference reshaping: interface rating, DSO anchor, voltage limits -- not shared-ESS capacity
